How Much Does 1800 GOT JUNK Cost in Phoenix?

If you’re scrolling through endless lists of junk‑removal companies, you’ve probably landed on 1-800-GOT-JUNK? and wondered, “What will this actually cost me in Phoenix?” The good news is that the pricing is transparent, based on the volume you need cleared, and there are plenty of ways to keep the bill low. Below we break down the pricing structure, the factors that can change the cost, and insider tips to get the best deal.

Understanding the 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Pricing Model

Unlike many local haulers that charge by the hour, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? uses a simple volume‑based system. Here’s how it works:

  • Standard Volume Packages: Each “junk bag” is roughly 5 cubic feet (about the size of a large trash bag). Prices start at one bag and increase in set increments.
  • Flat‑Rate per Bag: In Phoenix, a single bag typically costs between $89 and $99. Adding more bags reduces the per‑bag price slightly.
  • No Hidden Fees: The quote you receive includes labor, disposal, and any necessary permits. Taxes are added at checkout.

Typical Price Ranges in Phoenix

Below is a quick snapshot of what most Phoenix residents pay for common clean‑out projects. Prices are averages based on recent quotes from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? and can vary by season and exact location.

Small Jobs (1‑3 Bags)

  • 1 bag – $89‑$99
  • 2 bags – $169‑$189
  • 3 bags – $239‑$269

Medium Jobs (4‑6 Bags)

  • 4 bags – $299‑$329
  • 5 bags – $359‑$389
  • 6 bags – $419‑$449

Large Jobs (7+ Bags)

  • 7‑9 bags – $489‑$549
  • 10‑12 bags – $559‑$629
  • 13+ bags – Custom pricing (usually $50‑$60 per additional bag)

These numbers give you a baseline, but your final cost will depend on a few key variables.

What Factors Can Influence Your Final Bill?

Even with a straightforward per‑bag price, a few real‑world factors can nudge the cost up or down. Knowing these ahead of time helps you plan and avoid surprises.

1. Type of Junk

Most household items (furniture, appliances, electronics) are included in the standard rate. However, hazardous materials—like paint cans, batteries, or asbestos—may incur a surcharge.

2. Accessibility

If the junk is stacked in a cramped attic, basement, or behind a locked gate, crews may need extra time or equipment. That can add a small “access fee,” but 1-800-GOT-JUNK? typically handles most standard homes without extra charges.

3. Timing and Seasonality

Peak moving season (late spring to early fall) can see slightly higher demand, but the company often runs promotions that offset any increase. Booking during a weekday or off‑peak hour can sometimes shave $10‑$20 off the total.

4. Additional Services

Need a sweep of the site after removal? Want a recycling certification for your business? Those extra services are optional and priced separately.

How to Get the Most Accurate Quote

Getting a precise price is as easy as 1‑2‑3. Follow these steps to lock in your quote before the crew shows up:

  1. Measure Your Space: Estimate the cubic footage of the items you want removed. A quick way is to count the number of 5‑cubic‑foot bags you’d need.
  2. Use the Online Quote Tool: Visit the 1-800-GOT-JUNK? website, enter “Phoenix, AZ,” and input your bag estimate. The tool instantly shows the price range.
  3. Call for Confirmation: A friendly dispatcher can verify details, ask about any special items, and confirm the final cost.

Tips to Lower Your Junk Removal Bill in Phoenix

Even with a transparent pricing model, a little savvy can save you money. Here are five practical ways to keep costs down:

  • Pre‑Sort and Re‑Use: Items you can donate or sell (like gently used furniture) don’t need to be counted in your bag total.
  • Bundle Small Items: Pack screws, cords, and other tiny debris into a single bag to avoid “extra bag” fees.
  • Schedule During Off‑Peak Hours: Early mornings or mid‑week appointments often have the lowest demand.
  • Watch for Promotions: 1-800-GOT-JUNK? frequently runs seasonal discounts (e.g., “Spring Clean 10% Off”). Subscribe to their newsletter for alerts.
  • Combine Trips: If you have multiple clean‑outs (garage, yard, attic), consolidate them into one larger job rather than separate calls.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does 1-800-GOT-JUNK? recycle my items?

Yes! The company partners with local recycling facilities in Phoenix. Anything that can be repurposed—metal, wood, electronics—gets diverted from landfills.

What if I have more junk than I estimated?

During the on‑site assessment, the crew will let you know if you need extra bags. You’ll approve any additional cost before they start loading.

Can I cancel or reschedule?

Rescheduling is free up to 24 hours before the appointment. Cancellations made less than 24 hours out may incur a small fee.

Is there a minimum charge?

The minimum is one bag, so you’ll never pay less than the base rate for a single 5‑cubic‑foot load.
